svg.title: Two cache entries, two runs, one page
svg.desc: A sequence diagram of the transport's reference-time skew dance. A publish refreshes the manifest cache entry before the profile cache entry, so a consumer fetching both receives a manifest from the 06Z run and a profile from the 00Z run. loadForecast compares the pair's reference times with runsConsistent, waits 1.5 seconds, refetches, and returns either a consistent pair, the freshest complete pair marked stale, or a discriminated DocumentMiss.
